title: Nehru Report 1928
definition: The Nehru Report was the first major attempt by Indians to draft a constitutional framework for India, formulated by an All-Parties Conference in response to Lord Birkenhead's challenge to produce a consensus constitution.
importanceInUpsc: It marks the shift from 'Dominion Status' to 'Purna Swaraj' and highlights the growing communal divide in the Indian National Movement.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Nehru Report 1928.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
